title: Three Septembers and One Short Basket
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：grape　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grape 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the grower ① picked a grape that no picker in the vineyard would have described, and he said the picking was the whole of the September. The ② grape, meaning the fruit itself and not the wine, ran three Septembers and stayed undescribed in the book; a grape, he said, is the only thing in a vineyard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ grape in that vineyard had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ grape at the far row, meaning the bunch they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A grape, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grower said the describing is the part that fills three Septembers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grape was the whole of the matter, meaning the sweetness and not the fruit. The ⑥ grape, meaning the sweetness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grape, he said, is either something you pick or the only word that means both a fruit and a sweetness. He said the sweetness is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ grape had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ grape of the whole thing, the grower wrote in November, was one vineyard and three Septembers of describing; grape, he said, is either the bunch at the far row or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grape I remember is the grape described in the ledger, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the vineyard. A ⑩ grape, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being described; every grape, she said, is a sweetness that has agreed to look like a fruit. She said the sweetness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 葡萄（指园里每一颗旁边的那一颗）
B. n. 葡萄（指那种果实本身，与葡萄酒相对）
C. 固定搭配：pick a grape 摘一串葡萄
D. n. 葡萄（指留给孩子们吃的那一串）
E. n. 葡萄（抽象总称，指一处葡萄园的葡萄之事）
F. n. 葡萄（指账簿里写到、被称过的那些）
G. n. 葡萄色；深紫（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 葡萄紫（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: picked a grape that no picker in the vineyard would have described
The grape, meaning the fruit itself and not the wine
the grape at the far row
the grape was the whole of the matter
the grape had become a line in a ledger
The grape of the whole thing
A grape, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: pick a grape 意为“摘一串葡萄”，1968 年那位种植者摘了园子里没有一位采摘工肯描述的一串葡萄。
grape 意为“葡萄”，指那种果实本身而不是葡萄酒，它经过了三个九月而在簿子上没有被描述。
grape 意为“葡萄”，指园里每一颗旁边的那一颗，每一颗旁边都有同一只矮矮的篮子。
grape 意为“葡萄”，指最远那一行留给孩子们吃的那一串，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grape 意为“葡萄色、深紫”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片深紫就是那件事的全部。
grape 意为“葡萄紫”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些葡萄，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grape 意为“葡萄”，指账簿里写到、被称过的那些，到 1973 年这些成了账簿里的一行。
grape 意为“葡萄”，种植者十一月写道，整件事的葡萄之事是一处葡萄园和三个九月的描述。
grape 意为“葡萄”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那些，1975 年收完了，至今仍被说成园里最安静的一批。
grape 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，葡萄是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的果实。
